summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG), a foreign private issuer, announcing a revision to its medium-term business plan ROE target from approximately 9% to approximately 12% for FY2026. The revision is based on stronger-than-expected business performance in FY2024, which achieved the original target early. No transaction, tender offer, restructuring, or other special situation is involved. The filing is a routine strategic update and does not trigger any event-driven investing category.
